title: OBVRPFundsConfirmationRequest
description: The OBVRPFundsConfirmationRequest object must be used to request funds availability for a specific amount in the Debtor Account included in the VRP consents.

ConsentId.description: Unique identification as assigned by the ASPSP to uniquely identify the funds confirmation consent resource.

Reference.description: Unique reference, as assigned by the PISP, to unambiguously refer to the request related to the payment transaction. This must be the same value as the `Reference` field in the consent.

ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyCode.description: A code allocated to a currency by a Maintenance Agency under an international identification scheme, as described in the latest edition of the international standard ISO 4217 "Codes for the representation of currencies and funds".

OBActiveCurrencyAndAmount_SimpleType.description: A number of monetary units specified in an active currency where the unit of currency is explicit and compliant with ISO 4217.
